entry.headline: Weimar in two minds: care and carelessness, each strong, both real
entry.outlook: Weimar endures as a town of contradictions: green gestures and repair thrive alongside litter, e-waste, and a poisoned river—care and neglect locked in stalemate, each preventing the other from winning.
